faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: MOQ, samples, lead times and customization questions answered.
faq.content:
BUYER QUESTIONS

A clear start
to your project.

Answers to the questions we hear at the start of a private-label program.

What is your minimum order quantity?+

Our MOQ starts at 300 pieces. The final quantity breakdown across styles, sizes and colors is confirmed with your quotation.

How much do samples cost?+

Samples start at US$15. Custom development, additional versions and shipping are quoted separately for your project.

How long does sampling and production take?+

Sampling starts at 7 days and regular production at 15 days. Timing depends on approved specifications, materials, quantity and the production schedule. Your quotation confirms the schedule.

Can you customize both underwear and socks?+

Yes. We operate an underwear factory and a sock factory. We coordinate specifications, branding and packaging for both product categories.

Can I use my own design and logo?+

Yes. Send your artwork, measurements or reference sample. We review the construction, fabric, waistband or sock branding, and packaging before sampling.

Do you ship to the United States and Europe?+

Tell us your destination and requested delivery date. Shipping terms, freight costs and customs responsibilities will be confirmed in your quotation.

Can you share compliance documents?+

Request the documents required for your market and product. We will provide the relevant available documentation for review against your order specifications.

How do I send a tech pack?+

Email your tech pack and artwork to sales@wugan.net, or start with the project inquiry form. Include the style, fabric, quantity, destination and target launch date.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How WUGAN handles product inquiries and contact information.
privacy.content:
WUGAN

Privacy policy

Information submitted through this website is used to respond to your product inquiry.

Information you provide

When you contact us, we receive your name, email address, company, country and project requirements. Please send only information needed to discuss your project.

How we use it

We use inquiry information to respond, prepare quotations, discuss samples and manage your project. Inquiry records are available to authorized staff and our website and email service providers as needed for these purposes.

Retention and your choices

You may request access, correction or deletion of your inquiry information by contacting sales@wugan.net. We retain records as needed to respond and meet applicable business and legal obligations.

Cookies and external services

Essential website functions may use cookies. Links to WhatsApp open an external service governed by its own privacy policy. This theme does not include advertising trackers by default.

Contact

Email sales@wugan.net for privacy inquiries.
